dictionary.Del encanto de Gamla Stan a los museos d: From the charm of Gamla Stan to the museums of Djurgården and the viewpoints of Södermalm. Plan your getaway with an hourly itinerary, photos, and interactive maps.
dictionary.Frío, posibles heladas y viento. Prioriz: Cold, potential frost, and wind. Prioritize windproof outerwear, thermal layers, and boots with good grip.
dictionary.No necesitas pantalones de esquí para vi: You don't need ski pants to visit museums and stroll through the city.
dictionary.El mes más frío de media. Abrigo cálido,: The coldest month on average. A warm coat, gloves, a beanie, and waterproof footwear with good grip are priorities.
dictionary.Evita llenar la maleta de jerséis grueso: Avoid filling your suitcase with thick sweaters: layer your clothes and reuse your outerwear.
dictionary.Marzo sigue siendo frío, especialmente p: March remains cold, especially in the morning. Bring light thermal clothing, a coat, and waterproof footwear.
dictionary.No confíes solo en una chaqueta fina aun: Don't rely solely on a thin jacket, even if the calendar says it's spring.
dictionary.Mañanas frescas y tardes variables. Lo m: Cool mornings and variable afternoons. The most useful items are a waterproof jacket and easy-to-remove layers.
dictionary.No hace falta llevar cuatro abrigos: uno: There's no need to pack four coats: one versatile coat and a mid-layer usually work better.
dictionary.Días más suaves, aunque las mañanas y el: Milder days, though mornings and the archipelago can be cool. Combine t-shirts with sweatshirts and windbreakers.
dictionary.Deja en casa la ropa de nieve salvo que: Leave the snow gear at home unless you have planned specific activities.
dictionary.Días largos, ropa ligera y una capa extr: Long days, light clothing, and an extra layer for the evening or the ferry. Comfortable footwear and sunglasses are useful.
dictionary.No llenes la maleta de ropa pesada: norm: Don't pack heavy clothing: usually, a fine sweater is enough.
Typically one of the warmest months. Bring breathable clothing, a swimsuit if you'll be visiting the islands, and a light raincoat.
dictionary.No asumas sol todos los días: una chaque: Don't assume it will be sunny every day: a packable jacket is still practical.
dictionary.Todavía es verano, pero las lluvias son: It is still summer, but rain is common. Pack light clothing, comfortable sneakers, and waterproof protection.
dictionary.Un paraguas grande ocupa más que un impe: A large umbrella takes up more space than a lightweight, compact raincoat.
dictionary.Puede hacer buen tiempo durante el día y: It can be pleasant during the day and cool down at night. Bring a warm layer and comfortable footwear.
dictionary.Evita preparar una maleta plenamente inv: Avoid packing a full winter wardrobe if your trip is at the beginning of the month.
dictionary.El calzado de tela y una sola capa de ro: Canvas shoes and single layers of clothing are not very versatile at this time of year.
dictionary.Ya conviene preparar una maleta casi inv: It is already worth packing for near-winter weather: a warm coat, thin gloves, and layers for heated interiors.
dictionary.No necesitas llevar un jersey distinto p: You don't need a different sweater for every day: your coat and base layers are more important.
dictionary.Pocas horas de luz y frío húmedo. Lleva: Few hours of daylight and damp cold. Bring warm clothing, a hat, gloves, and footwear with good grip in case of ice.
dictionary.Para viajes de más de 10 días, esta list: For trips longer than 10 days, this list limits outfits to 10 days: we recommend planning a laundry day to avoid overpacking
dictionary.Calculamos ropa para hasta cinco días, c: We have calculated clothing for up to five days, assuming you will be able to do laundry during your trip.
dictionary.puedes llevar lo esencial y viajar liger: you can pack the essentials and travel light if you repeat items and wear your bulkiest clothes.
dictionary.podrás lavar ropa durante el viaje y pre: you will be able to do laundry during the trip and prepare changes for about five days, instead of multiplying your outfits. Check your airline's weight and size limits.
dictionary.las capas exteriores y la ropa térmica c: outer layers and thermal clothing fit better if you organize your luggage well and wear your coat.
dictionary.te permite llevar ropa versátil y algún: it allows you to carry versatile clothing and a few extras without having to check a bag, provided you respect the fare's size limits.
dictionary.el abrigo, la ropa térmica y los cambios: the coat, thermal clothing, and extra changes for a long trip may require more space, especially if you won't be able to do laundry.
dictionary.Con mínimas bajo cero, priorizaríamos ca: With temperatures below zero, we would prioritize thermal shirts, a windbreaker, and boots with good soles.
dictionary.Para los días fríos elegiríamos ropa tér: For cold days, we would choose thermal clothing, gloves, a beanie, and waterproof footwear, without filling the suitcase with thick sweaters.
dictionary.Aunque se acerque la primavera, aún llev: Even if spring is approaching, we would still bring a coat, a thin thermal layer, and moisture-resistant shoes.
dictionary.Para mañanas frescas y tardes variables,: For cool mornings and variable afternoons, we would combine a t-shirt, a sweater, and a waterproof jacket that you can easily take off.
dictionary.Con temperaturas suaves y mañanas fresca: With mild temperatures and cool mornings, we would bring light layers and a windbreaker, especially if you are visiting the archipelago.
dictionary.En los días más templados usaríamos ropa: On warmer days, we would wear breathable clothing and comfortable sneakers, but we would keep a light layer for the evening and the ferry.
dictionary.Priorizaríamos ropa ligera, calzado cómo: We would prioritize light clothing, comfortable footwear, and a thin sweatshirt for the afternoon: there is no need to carry heavy coats.
dictionary.Llevaríamos camisetas ligeras y calzado: We would bring light t-shirts and comfortable footwear, but also a windbreaker for weather changes.
dictionary.Para el contraste entre el día y la noch: To handle the contrast between day and night, we would combine light garments, a sweater, and an outer jacket.
dictionary.Con el ambiente fresco, optaríamos por p: With the cool atmosphere, we would opt for long trousers, a sweater, a waterproof jacket, and water-resistant footwear.
dictionary.Prepararíamos ya capas casi invernales:: We would already be preparing near-winter layers: a sweater, a warm coat, and fine accessories that are easy to remove indoors.
dictionary.Con frío y posibles heladas, priorizaría: With cold temperatures and possible frosts, we would prioritize a coat, a beanie, gloves, and waterproof footwear with good grip.
dictionary.En enero: abrigo cortavientos, térmicas: In January: a windbreaker, thermals, and high-grip footwear.
dictionary.En febrero: térmicas, abrigo cálido, gua: In February: thermals, a warm coat, gloves, and high-grip boots.
dictionary.En marzo: abrigo, una capa térmica y cal: In March: a coat, a thermal layer, and waterproof footwear.
dictionary.En mayo: capas ligeras y cortavientos pa: In May: light layers and windbreakers for the mornings and ferries.
dictionary.En junio: ropa ligera, zapatillas cómoda: In June: light clothing, comfortable sneakers, and a light layer.
dictionary.En septiembre: ropa versátil, jersey y u: In September: versatile clothing, a sweater, and a light jacket.
dictionary.En octubre: pantalón largo, jersey y cha: In October: long pants, a sweater, and a waterproof jacket.
dictionary.En noviembre: abrigo, capas y accesorios: In November: a coat, layers, and cold-weather accessories.
dictionary.En diciembre: abrigo cálido, gorro, guan: In December: a warm coat, beanie, gloves, and boots with good grip.
dictionary.Entre mañanas frescas y tardes suaves, l: Between cool mornings and mild afternoons, wear light layers and rain protection.
dictionary.Una chaqueta impermeable te ahorrará muc: A waterproof jacket will save you a lot of space.
dictionary.Días largos y temperaturas generalmente: Long days and generally pleasant temperatures. Don't forget a light layer for the evening.
dictionary.El frío gana terreno y el tiempo cambia: The cold is setting in and the weather changes quickly. Pair a warm sweater with a raincoat.
dictionary.Prioriza tejidos que sequen rápido y vis: Prioritize quick-drying fabrics and dress in layers.
dictionary.Capas térmicas, abrigo impermeable y cal: Thermal layers, a waterproof coat, and footwear with good grip for the cold and humidity.

dictionary.Gamla Stan es el lugar donde mejor se en: Gamla Stan is the best place to understand the origins of Stockholm. Its narrow, cobblestone streets wind through an old town filled with ochre facades, small squares, and churches. It is well worth wandering away from the main streets to discover quieter alleys.
dictionary.Djurgården combina museos conocidos con: Djurgården combines famous museums with green spaces and waterfront walks. Make sure to set aside time to explore the island itself, not just its museums.
dictionary.El Ayuntamiento y su torre de ladrillo r: The City Hall and its red brick tower facing Lake Mälaren are a city icon. You can enjoy beautiful views of the historic center from the gardens.
dictionary.Södermalm ofrece tiendas pequeñas, cafet: Södermalm offers small shops, cafes, residential streets, and viewpoints. Stroll through Mariatorget and head towards Monteliusvägen.
dictionary.Este paseo peatonal permite contemplar e: This pedestrian walkway offers views of Lake Mälaren, Riddarholmen, Gamla Stan, and City Hall. It easily integrates into a visit to Södermalm.
dictionary.Stortorget es la plaza más conocida de G: Stortorget is the most famous square in Gamla Stan. Its colorful facades are a classic image of Stockholm and it is located near the Royal Palace and the cathedral.
dictionary.Muy cerca de Gamla Stan, Riddarholmen re: Very close to Gamla Stan, Riddarholmen features a medieval church, ancient palaces, and a walkway with views toward City Hall.
dictionary.Un ferry permite entender la relación en: A ferry allows you to understand the relationship between the islands and observe the old town from a different perspective. Some services are part of the public transport system.
dictionary.El Palacio Real está junto a Gamla Stan: The Royal Palace is next to Gamla Stan, and its surroundings integrate easily into a walk through the old town. You can visit its rooms according to your interests.
dictionary.El paseo junto a los muelles de Strömkaj: A walk along the Strömkajen waterfront allows you to observe the city center from the water and connect different points of interest on foot.
dictionary.El Vasa conserva prácticamente completo: The Vasa preserves a nearly complete 17th-century warship that sank on its maiden voyage. Exploring its different levels allows you to see it from various heights and understand its history.
dictionary.Skansen reúne edificios tradicionales y: Skansen brings together traditional buildings and spaces dedicated to the cultural history of Sweden on the island of Djurgården.
dictionary.Fotografiska ofrece exposiciones de foto: Fotografiska offers contemporary photography exhibitions by the waterfront in Södermalm. The programming changes throughout the year.
dictionary.Este parque céntrico es un lugar para de: This central park is a place to rest between sightseeing, stroll, and soak up the Stockholm atmosphere.
dictionary.Imprescindibles de Estocolmo: mapa y con: Stockholm Must-Sees: map and tips | VCC
dictionary.Perderse también es viajar: Getting lost is part of the journey
dictionary.Naturaleza a un paso de la ciudad: Nature just a step away from the city
dictionary.No intentes encadenar todos sus museos e: Don't try to hit all the museums in a single day. Choose the ones that truly interest you and save time for a walk along the water: strolling around the island is free.
dictionary.La ciudad con otro ritmo: The city at a different pace
dictionary.Una ruta sencilla es comenzar en Mariato: A simple route is to start in Mariatorget, head towards Monteliusvägen, and continue discovering the neighborhood at your own pace. Wear comfortable shoes: you will encounter some hills.
dictionary.Integra este mirador en tu paseo por Söd: Incorporate this viewpoint into your Södermalm stroll instead of making a separate trip just to see it. If you are interested in the sunset light, check the sunset time and the forecast.
dictionary.No la planifiques como una visita indepe: Don't plan it as a standalone visit: it is located within Gamla Stan. Stop by to see the facades and then continue through the streets leading away from the square.
dictionary.Un rincón para parar: A corner to stop and rest
dictionary.Si ya visitas Gamla Stan, cruza hasta Ri: If you are already visiting Gamla Stan, cross over to Riddarholmen to see the City Hall from the shore. The outdoor walk is a quick stop and does not require an entrance fee.
dictionary.Para ver parte del arte del metro sin pe: To see part of the metro art without wasting half a day, combine T-Centralen, Stadion, and Kungsträdgården with your commutes. You will need a valid ticket.
dictionary.La ciudad vista desde el agua: The city viewed from the water
dictionary.Distingue el ferry público del crucero t: Distinguish between the public ferry and the sightseeing cruise: they have different routes and prices. Check the pier and use it to connect two visits.
dictionary.La ciudad empieza en sus muelles: The city begins at its docks
dictionary.Es un buen tramo para caminar junto al a: It is a great stretch for a walk by the water to watch the activity at the docks. If you want to board a boat, check which line departs from each pier beforehand.
Book several hours if you decide to go inside. Check which buildings, demonstrations, and activities are operational on your date: the experience changes quite a bit depending on the season.
dictionary.Antes de comprar la entrada, mira las ex: Before buying your ticket, check which exhibitions are on during your trip. It is a visit that is especially worth it if you are interested in current photography programs.
dictionary.Aprovéchalo como pausa entre visitas por: Use it as a break between visits in Norrmalm, rather than a destination in itself. Its atmosphere changes with the seasons, so plan your visit according to the weather.
dictionary.Reserva media jornada, traslados incluid: Book a half-day tour, transfers included. You can take a bus from Brommaplan or a boat from Stadshuskajen during the season. Confirm schedules and tickets.
dictionary.Sí, imprescindible en una primera visita: Yes, a must for a first visit: its streets are worth exploring even without entering any monuments.
dictionary.Sí, sobre todo si vas a elegir un único: Yes, especially if you are choosing only one museum. It is worth setting aside two hours and checking the entrance fee.
dictionary.Sí, especialmente si visitas el Vasa o S: Yes, especially if you visit the Vasa or Skansen. The best approach is to combine museums with a stroll around the island.
dictionary.Sí: incluso si no haces la visita interi: Yes: even if you don't go inside, the building and the waterfront views make the stop worthwhile.
dictionary.Sí, para pasear sin prisas y descubrir o: Yes, to wander without rushing and discover a different atmosphere. Combine it with a viewpoint instead of walking through the entire neighborhood.
dictionary.Sí, si el tiempo acompaña: es una parada: Yes, if the weather is good: it is a brief stop with great views that fits perfectly into a walk through Södermalm.
dictionary.Sí, pero como parte de Gamla Stan. Es un: Yes, but as part of Gamla Stan. It is a short stop: there is no need to plan a separate visit.
dictionary.Interesante si ya vas a utilizar el tran: Interesting if you are already using public transport. We wouldn't prioritize a long route of stations over the main sights.
dictionary.Sí, especialmente si lo integras como de: Yes, especially if you integrate it into your travel: seeing Stockholm from the water offers a different perspective.
dictionary.El exterior merece la parada al recorrer: The exterior is worth a stop while walking through Gamla Stan. The interior visit is even more rewarding if you are interested in real history.
dictionary.Sí, si te interesan las tradiciones suec: Yes, if you are interested in Swedish traditions or are traveling with family. Keep in mind that it requires several hours and an entrance fee.
dictionary.Agradable para descansar si pasas por el: Nice for a rest if you are passing through the center, but we wouldn't make a detour just to visit this park.
dictionary.Merece la pena como paseo de paso o ante: It is worth it as a quick stroll or before catching a boat. We wouldn't prioritize it as a standalone visit.
dictionary.Sí, volveríamos a recorrer sus callejuel: Yes, we would wander through its narrow alleys again without rushing, going beyond the main streets.
dictionary.Sí, para pasear con calma y descubrir má: Yes, to stroll calmly and discover more streets and cafes.
dictionary.Sí, si lo podemos encajar en la ruta por: Yes, if we can fit it into the Södermalm route, preferably in good light.
dictionary.No haríamos otra ruta exclusiva: veríamo: We wouldn't do another exclusive route: we would see the artistic stations during our journeys.
dictionary.Sí, repetiríamos un trayecto por el agua: Yes, we would take a trip by water again if it fits with our travels.
dictionary.Sí, como descanso al recorrer el centro,: Yes, as a break while exploring the center, but we wouldn't go exclusively for that.
dictionary.Depende del tiempo que tengas y de tus i: It depends on how much time you have and your interests.
